component.name: Recoolor
component.summary: Recolor GNOME apps with a palette

description.p: Pick a palette such as Catppuccin, Dracula or Tokyo Night, and Recoolor recolors GTK4, libadwaita and GTK3 apps. Choose one palette for light style and one for dark, and apps follow GNOME's style switch.
Recoolor backs up any stylesheet you already had, and Reset puts it back.
